thread:
emma_support: Heads-up: customer Report #4521 — embeddings dashboard shows 'vectors' and 'embedding_units' both spiking; they suspect double-counting and billing mismatch. They attached dashboard link and a CSV. https://console.redwood.ai/dash/abc123 :eyes:
liam_metrics: can you paste the chart permalink + timeframe? is this a new customer or existing?
emma_support: permalink: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/abc123?range=7d they say spike at 2025-11-09T14:03Z. customer is existing, high-volume ingest.
sofia_engineer: quick hypothesis: prefix caching vs batching telemetry might be counted twice in the rollup if both token->vector and vector emit events are tagged as "usage_unit". seen this once with a replay.
matt_billing: billing table shows units billed = 2x vectors in that window for cust_id=789. I can run a rollup diff.
liam_metrics: @sofia_engineer can you run this query on metrics-prod? I suspect kafka consumer replay produced duplicate event_ids for the same request_id when producer ack timed out.
sofia_engineer: running now, attaching query and sample rows.

```
SELECT request_id, event_type, count(*) as cnt, min(ts) as first_ts, array_agg(topic) as topics
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id = 789 AND ts BETWEEN '2025-11-09T13:50:00Z' AND '2025-11-09T14:15:00Z'
GROUP BY request_id, event_type
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

sofia_engineer: sample result: request_id=zz-123 repeated 3x: events: [ingest_vector, agg_rollup, billing_emit] across topics [producer-1,replay-2,rollup-worker]. counts look like same request reprocessed.

matt_billing: that request_id maps to invoice line items showing 3 units charged. customer says they only called embed once.

emma_support: customer provided application logs showing one API call at 2025-11-09T14:02:57Z with id zz-123. they also included our SDK response id: resp_zz-123.
liam_metrics: ok two potential issues: 1) producer ack timeout -> producer retried and message duplicated with same request_id but new event_id, 2) rollup consumer idempotency key missing for 'billing_emit' stage so duplicates generate separate unit counts.
sofia_engineer: investigating consumer side. initial find: rollup-worker was restarted at 14:01Z (deploy). logs show reprocessing backlog after restart. I see no idempotency lookup on billing_emit in the code path: billing_emit uses kafka offset only.

infra-bot: deploy detected: rollup-worker v2.4.1 restarted by ops at 2025-11-09T14:00:42Z (change: batching fix).

sofia_engineer: repro steps I used locally to simulate:
1) push message with request_id=R into topic producer-1, ack timeout -> retry publish same request_id to replay topic,
2) restart rollup-worker while backlog present,
3) run rollup which reads both original and replayed messages -> creates two billing emits.

sofia_engineer: quick fix idea: add idempotency_key = request_id to billing_emit records and dedupe at rollup aggregation (SQL-level), and make billing pipeline use LAST by event_ts per request_id when collapsing.

matt_billing: if we patch and deploy, will it retroactively fix already double-counted metrics? we need to correct the dashboard and issue credits.

liam_metrics: retro fix: run a backfill job to collapse duplicates in rollup_aggregate table for affected time windows (group by request_id, keep min(event_ts) and sum vectors only once). I'll draft the job.

emma_support: customer update: they asked for a timeline and whether charges will be reversed. I told them we have a hypothesis and we'll follow up with fix + credits if confirmed.
sofia_engineer: low-risk hotfix: add idempotency lookup in rollup-worker and run a guarded backfill. I'll open PR and include relevant test harness that replays kafka with duplicate messages.

liam_metrics: action items:
- sofia: PR for idempotency + unit tests (ETA 4h)
- liam: backfill job SQL + dry run (ETA 6h)
- matt: prepare billing credit script & customer comms draft (ETA EOD)
- emma: keep customer updated, ask for any extra logs if they have them

emma_support: thanks team. I'll mark as escalated and add to ticket. :thumbsup:
sofia_engineer: one more note: also double-check metrics pipeline that converts tokens->vectors. there is a mapping table that sometimes generates both token_count and vector_count events for same request if conversion job re-emits. but primary culprit looks like replay+during-deploy processing.
liam_metrics: adding a dashboard annotation for 2025-11-09 14:00 indicating rollup-worker restart so next time it's easier to correlate.

infra-bot: incident-note created: INC-20251109-embeds-dup. Rollup-worker restart tagged.
